title: What if you poured concrete into an ant hill?

shots.text: This is what's hiding under an ant hill.
Someone poured concrete into one to find out.
It flows down into every single tunnel and room...
and after a few days, it's hard as rock.
Then they dug all the dirt away...
and found an entire underground city.
Some colonies go over twenty feet deep, with more than a thousand rooms.
All built by ants, one tiny grain at a time.

youtube.title: What If You Poured Concrete Into an Ant Hill? 🐜 #shorts
youtube.description:
This is what's really hiding under an ant hill 😳

When people pour concrete into an ant colony and dig it out, they find an entire underground city: tunnels, rooms, and chambers stacked deep underground. Some leafcutter ant colonies go over 20 feet deep with more than a thousand rooms, all built by ants one grain at a time.

🐜 Did you expect it to be this big? Tell me in the comments.
🔔 Follow for more "what's under your feet" videos.
